noModelText: Download a model here, or put a .gguf file in the "models" folder.
starter1: Explain something difficult in simple terms
starter2: Help me write a polite email
starter3: Fix the language in this text
looped: The reply went into a loop and was stopped
trimmed: Older messages were left out to fit the context window
busy: Waiting for the previous reply to finish
contextHint: A larger window uses more memory. Changing it reloads the model.
threadsHint: Set roughly to the number of physical cores.
openFromShortcut: Could not connect. Start the app again with the shortcut.
editWarn: Replies after this message will be removed.
tooBig: Needs more memory than this PC has
kvHint: f16 uses half as much memory as f32.
downloadsHint: Files are downloaded into the "models" folder. You can also put a .gguf file there yourself.
skillsHint: Each file in the "skills" folder can define several /commands. Type /name at the start of a message to use it for that one reply.
skillContent:
## /name  Short description
The instruction the model should follow …
noCommands: No commands. Add one in Settings.
writeAfterCommand: Write a message after the command.
compressedNote: Older messages were summarized to save context
utilityAuto: Automatic (smallest model, else the same model)
utilityHint: Used when a long conversation has to be compressed. A small model is faster.
docsHint: Ask about the content of text files (.txt, .md ...). Answers are based on the most relevant excerpts.
docChunksHint: More excerpts give better answers but take longer to read.
noDocs: No documents yet. Press the paperclip next to the message box, or drop a file here.
dropHere: Drop the file to attach it
diagHint: Useful when something does not work: copy the report and send it.
shortcutsText: Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · Esc stops the reply · Alt+N new chat · Alt+B sidebar · / opens commands
